verdict.rationale: Paddle documents four official server-side SDKs (Node.js, Python, Go, PHP). The Node.js SDK ships TypeScript definitions, iterator pagination and webhook verification helpers, and the Python SDK handles pagination automatically and includes a webhook verifier. Paddle.js covers client-side checkout, an OpenAPI 3.1 spec supports generating other clients, and the docs MCP exposes SDK references to agents. Missing for 10: detailed documentation of the Go and PHP SDKs, and independent or hands-on corroboration of SDK quality.
